bw: Colloid builds up in the follicles
tp: When T3 and T4 cannot be made, TSH rises, colloid builds up and the thyroid enlarges. A goiter is only the visible sign of the deficiency.

ww.Exophthalmos: Exophthalmos is bulging of the eyes, seen with Graves’ disease.
ww.Acromegaly: Acromegaly is excess growth hormone in adults.

evidence: The accumulation of colloid increases the overall size of the thyroid gland, a condition called a goiter (Figure 17.14).

bw: Top preventable cause of intellectual disability
Lacking in the diet of landlocked regions
tp: Iodine deficiency impairs T3 and T4 synthesis. Iodized salt is the main dietary source in many countries.

ww.Vitamin D deficiency: The source ties preventable intellectual disability to iodine, not vitamin D.
ww.Vitamin C deficiency: Vitamin C deficiency is not linked to thyroid hormone synthesis.

evidence: Moreover, iodine deficiency is the primary cause of preventable intellectual disabilies worldwide.
